entries.jp: カイエス\n
entries.en: Caius

entries.jp: 「《緑星晶》のイミテーションか・・・」\f
entries.en: "An imitation of the Green Star Crystal..."
entries.speaker: カイエス\n

entries.jp: 「何か用か？」\f
entries.en: "Something you want?"
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: 「用がなければ帰れ！」\f
entries.en: "If you've no business here, go home!"
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: 「わしは、この国の領主ユーバウム公爵\n
entries.en: "I serve as aide to Duke Yubaum, the lord of this country. I was braced for the lord's wrath over losing the Green Star Crystal...
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: の側近を勤める者だ。《緑星晶》を失\n
った件で、領主様のお怒りを受けるの\n
は覚悟していたのに・・・\f
どうも、向こうでは今、それどころじ\n
entries.en: But it seems they have bigger worries over there right now. Whatever could have happened...
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: ゃないようだ。\n
いったい何が起こったのやら・・・\f
entries.speaker: ゃないようだ。

entries.jp: 一度、バルクルーサ城へ行って、確か\n
entries.en: I must go to Balkrutha Castle and see for myself."
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: めてみねばならんな」\f
「何でも、バルクルーサでは、近々戒厳\n
entries.en: "They say martial law is to be declared in Balkrutha any day now."
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: 令が発動されるというのだ」\f
町長\n
entries.en: Mayor
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: 「・・・ん、何ですと！？\n
entries.en: "...Hm? What's that?! You desire a Pass into Balkrutha? Hmmm...
entries.speaker: 町長
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: バルクルーサへ入る通行証をご所望と\n
な？う～む・・・\f
それは、この国の人間ならともかく、\n
entries.en: For a citizen of this country, perhaps, but for a traveler that's difficult, you see.
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: 旅のお人には難しいですぞ？\f
手柄のひとつも立てて、形だけでも名\n
entries.en: You'd have to earn some merit and become an honorary citizen, if only in name...
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: 誉市民ということになっていただかな\n
いと・・・\f
見たところ、あなたは剣の使い手のよ\n
entries.en: From the look of you, you're handy with a sword. And quite the expert, I'd say. Am I right?
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: うだ。それも、かなりの腕ききと見ま\n
したが、いかがでしょう？\f
その腕を以って、湿原にいる魔物たち\n
entries.en: With that skill of yours, could you defeat the boss of the monsters in the Marshland?
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: のボスを倒せますかな？\f
まあ、無理にとは言いませんが。\f
entries.en: Now, not that I'm insisting, mind you.
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: シートロルという怪力の魔物で、こ奴\n
entries.en: It's a monster of tremendous strength called the Sea Troll, and we're at our wits' end with the brute. Why, it can sink a small boat with a single blow.
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: には、ほとほと手を焼いておるのです。\n
なにしろ、小さな船だったら一撃で沈\n
めてしまうような奴ですから。\f
ええ、どうしても倒せとは言いません\n
entries.en: Oh, I'm not saying you absolutely must defeat it.
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: よ。\f
しかし、森の島に調査に行ったという、\n
entries.en: Still, I'm worried about the scholars who went to survey the Forest Island. If the Sea Troll has found them...
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: 学者たちの様子も気になります。\n
もし、シートロルに見つかってたらと\n
思うと・・・\f
ああ！　無力な一介の町長であるこの\n
entries.en: Oh! What can I possibly do, a mere powerless mayor?!
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: 私に、何ができるというのでしょう！？\f
森の島は湿原の北東の端から行けます。\n
entries.en: The Forest Island lies past the northeast end of the Marshland. The path opens only at low tide.
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: 引き潮の時だけ、道が通じるのです。\f
絶対に行け、とは言いませんがね・・\n
entries.en: Not that I'm saying you absolutely must go, mind you..."
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: 町長\n
entries.en: Mayor
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: 「ところで、港の看板をご覧になりまし\n
entries.en: "By the way, have you seen the signs at the port? Those were all decided by the capital. They're not my doing.
entries.speaker: 町長
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: たか？あれらは全て中央の決定なので\n
す、私の責任ではありません。\f
私はむしろ、必死に抗議しました。\n
entries.en: In fact, I protested desperately. True, we don't know what caused the storm, but we can't keep the sailors idle any longer.
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: 嵐の原因が分からぬとはいえ、現場の\n
船乗りたちを、これ以上、遊ばしてお\n
くわけにもいかず、船の運行を再開さ\f
せようとした矢先でしたからね。\f
entries.en: I was just about to get the ships running again, you see.
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: それをいきなり、完全閉鎖するとは・\n
entries.en: And then, out of the blue, total closure... It makes no sense. Those on high think too little of the port."
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: ・・もう、サッパリ分かりません。\n
上の方々は港の重要性を軽く見すぎて\n
おられる」\f
町長\n
entries.en: Mayor
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: 「まだ何か？\n
entries.en: "Something else? ...The Forest Island lies past the northeast end of the Marshland, you know."
entries.speaker: 町長
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: ・・・森の島は湿原の北東の端から行\n
けますよ？」\f
町長\n
entries.en: Mayor
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: 「え～と、どちら様でしたかな？」\f
entries.en: "Errr, and who might you be?"
entries.speaker: 町長
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: 町長\n
entries.en: Mayor
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: 「・・・おお、そういえば、あなた\n
entries.en: "...Oh, now I remember. You're the one...
entries.speaker: 町長
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: なにっ？！\n
entries.en: What?! You defeated the Sea Troll?! Oh! I never dreamed you'd actually pull it off!
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: シートロルを倒したとな！？\n
entries.speaker: なにっ？！

entries.jp: おお！　まさか、本当にやってのける\n
とは！\f
・・・いやいや、正直なところ、どう\n
entries.en: ...Well, well, to be honest, I assumed you'd run off, and forgot all about you. How embarrassing.
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: せ逃げただろうと、すっかり忘れてお\n
りました。\n
面目ない。\f
entries.speaker: りました。

entries.jp: こうなった以上、お望み通り、通行証\n
entries.en: Things being what they are, I must issue the Pass as you wish. ...There, it's done. Take this with you."
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: を発行するしかないでしょう。\n
・・・さあ、できました。\n
これを持って行きなさい」\f
entries.speaker: ・・・さあ、できました。

entries.jp: 《通行証》を手に入れた\f
entries.en: Obtained the Pass.
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: 町長\n
entries.en: Mayor
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: 「バルクルーサは、かなり不穏な情勢に\n
entries.en: "Things in Balkrutha seem to be quite unsettled. Do take care."
entries.speaker: 町長
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: なっとるようです。\n
どうぞ、お気をつけて」\f
entries.speaker: なっとるようです。

entries.jp: 「剣など振り回して、得意になってる輩\n
entries.en: "I've no fondness for types who swing swords around and think they're something. Please leave."
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: は好みません。出ていってください」\f
「いつのまにか宝石がすり変わってたな\n
entries.en: "The jewel got swapped at some point... Like, no waaay!! ...Y'know?"
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: んて・・・\n
うっそ！！\n
entries.speaker: んて・・・

entries.jp: ・・・って感じ」\f
entries.speaker: うっそ！！

entries.jp: 「みんな、あの黒髪の人を泥棒の一味み\n
entries.en: "Everyone's talking about that black-haired lady like she's one of the thieves, but I can't believe that.
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: たいに言ってるけど、わたしにはそう\n
思えません。\f
だって、とっても澄んできれいな目を\n
entries.en: After all, she had such clear, beautiful eyes..."
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: した人だったんですもの・・・」\f
警備隊長\n
entries.en: Guard Captain
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: 「用心棒は、不審な娘を取り逃がしたの\n
entries.en: "I fired the bodyguard for letting that suspicious girl get away. Where he drifted off to after that, I don't know."
entries.speaker: 警備隊長
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: でクビにしてやった。その後、どこへ\n
流れて行ったかは知らん」\f
「ここの地下には、高価で貴重な宝石が\n
entries.en: "A costly, precious jewel was kept below here. But at some point, it got swapped for a fake."
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: 保管されていたしかし、それがいつの\n
間にか、ニセモノにすり替えられてし\n
まったのだ」\f
「隣の部屋にいた用心棒・・・\n
entries.en: "The bodyguard who was in the next room... What a relief he's gone. ...It felt like living with Death."
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: あいつがいなくなってホッとしたよ。\n
・・・死に神と暮らしてる気分だった\n
からな」\f
